<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the comparison between two URLs.

The first URL example showed `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` with a note about parameter order, implying the second URL demonstrates a contrasting case (e.g., missing parameters or different ordering).

Final token `?flag` is the start of a second URL's query string (`https://example.com/?flag`), immediately requiring either `=true` or another parameter continuation, mirroring the first URL's structure but with fewer parameters.
"
URL 1: `https://example.com/?foo=1&bar=2&flag`
URL 2: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the pattern suggests the next token completes the query string, likely referencing the same `flag` parameter mentioned earlier.</explanation>
